node.label: J&K politics & Statehood
node.summary: Politics of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir and the demand for Statehood.

facts.text: Mains angle: restoration of Statehood, the elected government vs the Lieutenant Governor in a UT, and preventive laws vs political outreach.
facts.plain: Mains angle: restoration of Statehood, the elected government vs the Lieutenant Governor in a UT, and preventive laws vs political outreach.

facts.text: **Mehbooba Mufti** (PDP): jailing people under **UAPA** and the **Public Safety Act** won't solve Kashmir; she wants talks and trade routes to Kashgar and Khotan.
facts.plain: Mehbooba Mufti (PDP): jailing people under UAPA and the Public Safety Act won't solve Kashmir; she wants talks and trade routes to Kashgar and Khotan.

facts.text: J&K Deputy CM: **Surinder Choudhary**. NC general secretary: **Ali Muhammad Sagar**.
facts.plain: J&K Deputy CM: Surinder Choudhary. NC general secretary: Ali Muhammad Sagar.

facts.text: About **20 National Conference MLAs** sent a 10-point memo to Farooq and Omar Abdullah seeking party reforms, manifesto delivery and a stronger push for **Statehood**. They met at MLA Qaiser Jamsheed Lone's home on 27 Oct.
facts.plain: About 20 National Conference MLAs sent a 10-point memo to Farooq and Omar Abdullah seeking party reforms, manifesto delivery and a stronger push for Statehood. They met at MLA Qaiser Jamsheed Lone's home on 27 Oct.

facts.text: J&K CM **Omar Abdullah** (56) married journalist **Nidhi Razdan**.
facts.plain: J&K CM Omar Abdullah (56) married journalist Nidhi Razdan.

facts.text: Under the **J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019**, the UT's Council of Ministers cannot exceed **10%** of the 90-member Assembly, so nine is the maximum.
facts.plain: Under the J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019, the UT's Council of Ministers cannot exceed 10% of the 90-member Assembly, so nine is the maximum.

facts.text: **17 National Conference MLAs** gave a 15-day ultimatum to **Farooq** and **Omar Abdullah** over 'coterie culture' after CM Omar Abdullah expanded his Cabinet from **six to nine** ministers.
facts.plain: 17 National Conference MLAs gave a 15-day ultimatum to Farooq and Omar Abdullah over 'coterie culture' after CM Omar Abdullah expanded his Cabinet from six to nine ministers.

facts.text: Anantnag District Magistrate declared the **27 Oct** District Bar Association elections 'null and void' for being held without permission.
facts.plain: Anantnag District Magistrate declared the 27 Oct District Bar Association elections 'null and void' for being held without permission.
